source_alignment_caveat: BraTS 2021 Task 2 predicts MGMT, not BCER HGG/LGG. The segmenter may use a T1c/FLAIR heuristic fallback when dependencies are unavailable and can create a synthetic ellipsoid. A source comment says missing bundle triggers fallback, but with dependencies present bundle failure raises. The report helper reads run state, sequence mapping, segmentation status and feature evidence; it does not directly fetch predicted_grade.

task_contract.conditional_registration: register_to_reference is deliberately NOT a required stage: BraTS-style inputs arrive already co-registered at 1x1x1 mm, so a correct plan skips it. Scoring keys off the segmentation/feature/grade/report stages, which are mandatory regardless of input geometry.
task_contract.evaluation_boundary: tool success, path/format and nonempty fields; no image overlap, grade truth or diagnostic adjudication
task_contract.goal_template: Task: long_brain_full. Requested workflow type: full_pipeline. Domain: {domain}. Case ID: {case_id}. Execute identify->(register T2,FLAIR->T1c if not already co-registered)->brats-segment->features->grade-classify->report using T1/T1c/T2/FLAIR. Case root: {case_root}.
task_contract.suite_template_discrepancy: benchmark_suite.template.json lists register_to_reference among stages, while tasks_registry.json explicitly excludes it for pre-registered BraTS-style inputs. Runner loads the registry task contract; this explainer follows that contract.
task_contract.segmentation_fallback: MONAI bundle preferred; heuristic fallback only when dependency check fails. Threshold WT<=32 voxels can be replaced by an ellipsoid, so nonempty mask is not anatomical validation.
task_contract.grade_rule: Whole-tumor feature volume threshold with texture fallback; confidence is code-derived, not calibrated clinical probability.

report_consumption.reads: case_state records, identify_sequences mapping, optional registration record, brats_mri_segmentation success, extract_roi_features result/CSV previews, ROI WT/TC/ET volumes and optional structured image QC
report_consumption.report_json: case/run/domain, sequence mapping, feature path, stage status (including optional registration), brain_assessment segmentation flag and WT/TC/ET volumes; not grade truth
report_consumption.caution: A correctly skipped conditional registration can appear missing in generic report stage_status; this is not task failure.
report_consumption.model_boundary: Brain defaults llm_mode to server and may attempt structured report/image QC through configured adapter; separate from deterministic report JSON. No model or adapter was executed.
